temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems withdrawn and down during shifts. When Jose asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff but does not share details. She thanks him and says his offer to listen means a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant; Jose has no specific reason to think something is seriously troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her withdrawn behavior and guarded but appreciative response suggest something personal is bothering her, though she is not ready to discuss it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with a personal issue, and she appreciates Jose's supportive offer, but she is not ready to open up yet.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without pushing her to share more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. She confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and accepts his offer to discuss budgeting or financial planning sometime.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia may be dealing with a personal issue and appreciates his support, but Jose does not know the specific nature of the problem.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose learns that finances are a concrete source of stress for Patricia, and she seems open to receiving practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is under financial stress and may welcome help with budgeting or financial planning when she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, sympathy, and eagerness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer practical financial planning or budgeting support when Patricia feels up to discussing it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that she did not think he was prying and says she is grateful for his offer to help. Jose explains he respects her privacy and only wants to support her as a friend; she says she appreciates having someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose is unsure whether bringing up financial planning overstepped Patricia's boundaries, even though she accepted his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's reassurance resolves his worry: she does not feel he was prying and values his supportive intent.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his support and sees him as a friend; he can continue helping while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while being careful to respect her boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is going well and that she plans a quiet weekend at home. She does not mention her troubles or request help, but thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and did not mind his earlier offer; Jose may still expect she might take him up on financial help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's brief, polite response and quiet-weekend plan suggest she appreciates concern but likely prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values Jose's concern but probably wants to manage her personal matters on her own for now; he should remain available without prying.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, with some uncertainty and acceptance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain friendly check-ins and offer support without pressuring Patricia or bringing up her problems directly.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia tells Jose she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support. Jose reiterates that he is available to help with anything, even something small like coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but likely prefers privacy and to handle her issues herself; low-pressure support is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change, but it reinforces that Patricia is managing and values his supportive presence without asking for more detailed help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and appreciates Jose's continued support; he should keep offering low-pressure availability.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular supportive check-ins and offer practical help if needed, without prying into her personal matters.
